comment: Worked out by hand (mitcad#1994), format 57 as SolidCraft 0.43.0 reads it: a 40 x 20 rectangle extruded on two sides with entered distances -2 and 6 (Direction fixes the sides, a sign turns its own side over: from z = -6 to -2, 3200); two pins of radius 3 and 10 high joined on its top (2 * 90 pi); a hole of 4.2 through it with a cosmetic M5 of class 6H (no geometry): 17.64 pi; a counterbored hole of 3 through, its bore 6 wide and 1 deep: 9 pi + 6.75 pi; one cosmetic M6 thread feature on both pins (no geometry). The slab: 3200 + 146.61 pi = 3660.5889. A ring: a 4 x 10 rectangle 6 to 10 from a fixed axis whose origin is the parameter cx (60) turned a full turn: 640 pi = 2010.6193; a collar: a 2 x 10 rectangle 4 to 6 from a line of another sketch turned a full turn: 200 pi = 628.3185; a 10 mm cube placed by its center (100, 0, 0): 1000. Total 7299.5267.
